candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion at the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle and fail with DependencyUnavailable after ~2s, causing order 503s, gateway ReadTimeout on /v1/orders, and 502s on /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres-side pool metrics or DB logs; pool size 5/idle 0 inferred from client span attributes only.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout correlation failing at postgres.save_order with pool size 5, idle 0, and DependencyUnavailable after ~2s, propagating to order 503 and gateway ReadTimeout/502. Redis and payment calls succeed, so redis-timeout and downstream-latency are not supported. Pool exhaustion is the bounded cause consistent with current evidence.
